id./param/scenario/cs/c_110_cs_030.pack|cs_:
"Hendrik, you did great! Truly a hero.
  Watching your brave fight reminded me
  of the chivalry Papa taught me.

"I hate to admit it, but my good moves were
  thanks to Norberto's support.
  Your maiden's heart is quite something too.

"But odd, isn't it?
  Papa said defeating the trial giant
  would give us the strongest weapon...
"Master! When did you get here!?

"Ha ha ha! You passed the trial!
  I never thought you greenhorns
  would get this far!

"Hey, Papa! You said passing the trial
  gets us the strongest weapon.
  That's a bald-faced lie!

"What are you talking about?
  You've already got it.
  ...The strongest weapon.

"What do you mean, Papa?
  Quit being coy and just say it.

"Master, could it be...
  The strongest weapon is Norberto's
  and my...

"Sharp as ever, Hendrik. Yes, you two
  overcoming the trial in sync
  was the true aim.

"Fighting in focus, hearts connected,
  sharpens the mind, and new talent
  awakens to cover your weaknesses.

"Sleeping talent stirred by your partner,
  and the bond of cooperation: that is
  the strongest weapon. Feel it, don't you?
"Th-this is!!

Sylvando's skill
'Chivalry' was unlocked!

Hendrik's skill
'Compassion' was unlocked!

"...You've only just got your sword.
  Keep honing each other together.
  Ha ha ha!

"Wait a moment! Don't say that,
  Papa, hone yourself with us too!
"...Wh-why does it come to that!

"Bonds of cooperation are the strongest
  weapon, right? Then three are far
  stronger than two.

"And you said before you'd help us
  until that black sun is smashed.

"...A knight never goes back on his word.
  Right?

"...Having Master fight with us is reassuring.
  I ask you as well.

"Gaah, fine, fine!
  My sword isn't rusty yet!
  I'll back you up, so call me anytime!

Sylvando and Hendrik can now use
the Pep Power 'Summon Mentor'!
